turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Hi Bob, I just started my new job at the tech company downtown.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: That's great Alice! What role are you in?

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: I'm a senior software engineer working on the cloud infrastructure team.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Nice. I remember you used to work at the startup on 5th Street. Why did you leave?

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: The startup ran out of funding last March. I was looking for something more stable.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Makes sense. How's the commute from Chapel Hill?

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: About 30 minutes by bus. I moved to Chapel Hill last year after finishing my master's at UNC.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Oh right, your master's in computer science. Congrats again on that!

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Thanks! I'm also thinking about adopting a dog. I've been looking at the shelter on Maple Street.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: A dog would be great company. What breed are you thinking?

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: I'd love a golden retriever. My family had one when I was growing up in Raleigh.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Golden retrievers are wonderful. How's your garden doing? You mentioned planting tomatoes.

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: The tomatoes are doing great! I also planted some basil and rosemary this season.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Nice. I tried gardening last summer but the deer kept eating everything.

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: You should try a fence. I built one with cedar posts from the hardware store on Broad Street.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Good idea. By the way, are you still playing tennis on weekends?

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: I stopped last month because of a knee injury. I've been swimming at the YMCA pool instead.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Sorry about the knee. Swimming is good low-impact exercise though.

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Yeah, I actually prefer it now. The YMCA on Rosemary Street has a great lap pool.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: I should join you sometime. I've been meaning to exercise more.

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: Dave, I finally finished my PhD dissertation on marine biology at Duke University.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: Congratulations Carol! That's a huge achievement. What was your research focus?

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: I studied coral reef ecosystems in the Caribbean, specifically the impact of ocean acidification.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: Fascinating. Are you planning to continue in academia?

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: I accepted a postdoc position at the marine lab in Wilmington. I start next September.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: Wilmington is beautiful. Will you still be living in Durham?

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: I'm moving to Wilmington in August. I already found an apartment near Wrightsville Beach.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: Living near the beach sounds amazing. I remember you used to surf every weekend.

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: Yes! I learned to surf when I was studying abroad in Costa Rica during my undergrad at UNC Wilmington.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: You've had quite the academic journey. UNC Wilmington to Duke for your PhD.

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: Indeed. I also did a summer internship at the NOAA lab in Beaufort between my undergrad and grad school.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: That must have been valuable experience. What about your dog, Biscuit?

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: Biscuit is coming with me! He's a border collie I adopted from the Durham Animal Shelter two years ago.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: He'll love the beach. Are you still cooking those amazing Thai curries?

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: Absolutely. I actually started growing my own lemongrass and Thai basil in my garden.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: Impressive! I tried growing herbs but my apartment doesn't get enough sunlight.

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: You could try grow lights. I got mine from the garden center on Ninth Street.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: Good tip. By the way, I heard you switched from coffee to tea recently.

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: Yes, my doctor recommended cutting back on caffeine. I've been drinking green tea from the shop on Foster Street.

turns.speaker: Dave
turns.text: I should try that too. My New Year's resolution was to eat healthier.
